description.value:
You belong to one of Dathomir's Force-sensitive clans, a matriarchal warrior society bound to a Clan Mother and to the wild magic of your homeworld. Your training fused muscle and the Force into a single discipline, and every clan holds to its own laws above all else: as your own clan's book of laws puts it, "never concede to evil."

Far from Dathomir's mists, that bond to your sisters hasn't faded, and neither has the wariness other Force traditions tend to feel around you.

system.equipment: A copy of your clan's book of laws, a set of traveler's clothes, and a pouch containing 150 credits.
